senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="S01568">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 31:18">Targ. Gen. XXXI, 18</cite>.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 47:23">Targ. Y. ib. XLVII, 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 82b:6">Keth. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>דקְנָאִי ודקָנִינָא</he> which I have acquired (own), and which I may acquire in the future.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 44b:6">B. Bath. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>דאִיקְנֵי קנה וכ׳</he> if the document reads ‘that which I may obtain’ (shall be seizable for my debt), and be bought and sold again …, it cannot be seized; <cite ref="Bava Batra 157a">ib. 157ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 66b:4">B. Mets. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>וא״ל קְנִי קְנֵי</he> and he said to him, take possession (of the collateral, I shall not redeem it), he has obtained it.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 66b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>כל דְּאִי לא קָנֵי</he> an obligation with an ‘if’ (conditional forfeiture) gives no title; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zechariah 13:5">Targ. Zech. XIII, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 21:3">Targ. II Chr. XXI, 3</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 44b:4">B. Bath. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>אי א׳ … אגב וכ׳</he> if he gave him possession of movable chattel by dint of immovables jointly sold (v. <cite ref="A00235"><he>אַגַּב</he></cite>) &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72a:10">B. Mets. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>אַקְנְיֵיה לבנו וכ׳</he> he signed it over to his minor son.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 7a:5">Kidd. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>מַקְנְיָא נפשה</he> she may give possession of herself (become his wife); a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 77a:1">B. Bath. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיקְּנִין</he> (Rashb. <he>מִיקְּנוּ</he>), v. <cite ref="M01165"><he>מִילָּא</he> II</cite>.
